source: capiro-backend bd4136654a286a1526aa98d5f0fba1301a0a77e9 (PR 362), apps/api/prisma/migrations/20281101010000_capiro_data_published_surface/migration.sql: view and column comments as describe_capiro_data publishes them (types come from the catalog at run time)

congress_bills.description: Canonical federal bills; id includes Congress, bill type and number.
limitations: Published metadata does not establish active grants, populated rows, ingestion completeness or source freshness.
Sponsor display name is not an identity key; member resolution can be absent.

congress_bill_subjects.description: Named subject assertions associated with canonical bill IDs.
limitations: Published metadata does not establish active grants, populated rows, ingestion completeness or source freshness.
(bill_id, name) is not unique. Deduplicate bill IDs before counting bills.
Published metadata does not establish active grants, populated rows, ingestion completeness or source freshness.
Use withdrawn_date IS NULL for active cosponsors. A missing member row does not remove the canonical cosponsor ID.
Published metadata does not establish active grants, populated rows, ingestion completeness or source freshness.
Current roster status does not establish historic membership. Names are not unique.

program_elements.description: Active public DoD program elements and procurement budget lines.
limitations: Published metadata does not establish active grants, populated rows, ingestion completeness or source freshness.
Retired records are excluded. Appropriation type distinguishes RDT&E PEs from procurement lines.

program_element_projects.description: Projects/sub-elements with mission narrative and nullable source locators.
limitations: Published metadata does not establish active grants, populated rows, ingestion completeness or source freshness.
Several projects can match one PE; deduplicate PE IDs before aggregating parent funding.

program_element_budget_positions.description: PE-level budget assertions, independent of project funding grain.
program_element_budget_positions.grain: One row per (pe_code, position_cycle, asserted_fy, value_kind).
limitations: Published metadata does not establish active grants, populated rows, ingestion completeness or source freshness.

Position cycle identifies the asserting book/stage; asserted FY identifies the year funded. PB outyears are not that future year’s submitted request. Filter value_kind and cycle before summing. Use the PE timeline for consolidated/current/enacted funding.
Joining multiple projects can multiply parent amounts; SUM(DISTINCT amount) also loses equal-valued parents.

position_cycle.description: Budget book/stage that asserted this amount, e.g. pb_fy2026.

asserted_fy.description: Fiscal year FOR which this position asserts a value.

value_kind.description: total, quantity or (PE only) unit_cost; never combine different kinds.

amount.description: total: USD millions; quantity: units; unit_cost: USD millions per unit.

created_at.description: Stored row creation time, not source freshness.

program_element_project_budget_positions.description: Project-level budget assertions; amount total is USD millions.
program_element_project_budget_positions.grain: One row per (pe_code, project_code, position_cycle, asserted_fy, value_kind).
limitations: Published metadata does not establish active grants, populated rows, ingestion completeness or source freshness.

Position cycle identifies the asserting book/stage; asserted FY identifies the year funded. PB outyears are not that future year’s submitted request. Filter value_kind and cycle before summing. Use the PE timeline for consolidated/current/enacted funding.
Project value_kind supports total or quantity; project sums need not equal PE totals.

position_cycle.description: Budget book/stage that asserted this amount, e.g. pb_fy2026.

asserted_fy.description: Fiscal year FOR which this position asserts a value.

value_kind.description: total, quantity or (PE only) unit_cost; never combine different kinds.

amount.description: total: USD millions; quantity: units; unit_cost: USD millions per unit.

created_at.description: Stored row creation time, not source freshness.

client_objectives.description: Current nondeleted standalone client objectives, including complete stored business fields and readiness. Independent of Strategy goals and advocacy history.
client_objectives.grain: One current nondeleted standalone Objective per canonical id, within its client_id.
limitations: Only currently authorized, nonarchived clients and nondeleted Objectives. General covers the current visible client roster; selected-client scope cannot broaden it.
No automatic-context three-item sample or hidden list cap. Explicit SQL filters/limits and output bounds still apply; returned rows do not establish source-universe completeness.
Create-request hashes, revision history and operational plans/ledgers are not exposed. Current Objective version and readiness do not authorize a write.

id.description: Canonical client Objective ID; never a Strategy goal or task ID.

client_id.description: Canonical client ID. Include it when joining activity to an Objective.

request_id.description: Original create-request correlation ID, not an approval, permission or current version.

outcome.description: Full stored desired outcome, including an empty draft value.

government_problem.description: Full stored government problem, including an empty draft value.

ask_type.description: funding, policy_authority, both, protect_funding or meri_propose; null when unselected.

minimum_win.description: Full stored minimum win, including an empty draft value.

limits.description: Full stored limits; not a required readiness field.

owner_user_id.description: Attributed Objective owner; ownership does not narrow the read ACL.

created_by_user_id.description: Attributed creator, not an additional read ACL.

status.description: Stored draft, in_review or ready lifecycle state; independent of the computed readiness checklist.

version.description: Current Objective optimistic-concurrency version, not a source-universe version.

updated_at.description: Stored Objective modification time; not proof of source freshness.

readiness_outcome.description: Outcome has content after the canonical ECMAScript whitespace trim.

readiness_government_problem.description: Government problem has content after the canonical whitespace trim.

readiness_ask_type.description: Ask type is one of the five supported Objective ask types.

readiness_minimum_win.description: Minimum win has content after the canonical whitespace trim.

readiness_completed_fields.description: Number of true readiness checklist fields, from zero through four.

readiness_required_fields.description: Four, matching objectiveReadiness; limits and attribution are not required.

readiness_is_ready.description: All four checklist fields are complete. This does not change the stored lifecycle status.

client_activity.description: Recorded client activity rows with complete stored business fields and validated Quick Log details. This is not the mixed Timeline union.
client_activity.grain: One stored client activity row per canonical id, within its client_id.
limitations: Stored client_activity rows only. No derived Timeline meetings, attachments, outreach drafts or mail threads, and no hidden first-500 Timeline union.
Malformed or legacy Quick Log metadata yields null detail fields as in projectActivityDetails; unrelated metadata is never exposed.
Objective linkage is historical and soft. Use a LEFT JOIN on both client_id and objective_id to retain unavailable references; never infer current status from a recorded version.
Underlying person/source IDs are references only. Their owners still enforce their own visibility. Query filters, row limits and byte truncation do not establish complete client history.

id.description: Canonical recorded activity ID, not a derived Timeline synthetic ID.

client_id.description: Canonical client ID; use with objective_id for the Objective relationship.

kind.description: Stored activity kind, including note, request, decision and commitment.

occurred_at.description: Recorded occurrence time; may differ from insertion time.

title.description: Full stored title, without an excerpt limit.

body.description: Full stored body; null and empty text remain distinct.

actor_user_id.description: Attributed actor, not an additional read ACL.

person_id.description: Stored person reference; not evidence of current Directory visibility.

source_type.description: Stored underlying-record type; does not grant access to that record.

source_id.description: Stored underlying-record identity; does not grant access to that record.

settled_at.description: Stored settlement time; null does not imply a due date.

created_by_user_id.description: Attributed creator, not an additional read ACL.

updated_at.description: Stored row modification observation; this is not a version or concurrency token.

origin.description: Always recorded. Derived meeting, document, outreach and mail Timeline items are excluded.

direction.description: Validated Quick Log we_owe or they_owe, otherwise null.

counterparty.description: Validated manually entered label, preserved verbatim; not a Directory identity.

objective_id.description: Validated historical Objective reference; may be unavailable now.

objective_version.description: Validated historical Objective version selected when the activity was recorded.

objective_revision_id.description: Validated historical Objective revision ID; not a current revision or read authorization.

objective_availability.description: current when the visible nondeleted same-client Objective has the recorded version; changed for a different version; unavailable when absent; null without a valid reference.

client_team_roster.description: Complete saved account team: ranked owners merged once per user with explicit team memberships, as the account-team reader presents them.
client_team_roster.grain: One row per (client_id, user_id), even when an owner also has an explicit team membership.
limitations: Only current authorized nonarchived clients are visible. Query limits do not establish tenant-wide completeness.
Owners retain the explicit membership role but have null membership_id and added_at, matching the account-team owner.
Inactive owner names remain in this roster. The separate ordered-owner projection redacts unavailable person fields.
Not a directory of all tenant users and not an access-grant list. No hidden first-page roster sample.

client_id.description: Canonical client ID; include it in roster/owner joins.

user_id.description: Canonical assigned user ID. Assignment confers no client or wall access.

membership_id.description: Explicit team membership row ID; null for every ranked owner.

email.description: Current assigned user email, including historical inactive ranked owners.

role.description: Full free-text explicit team role; null means no stated role, not a missing row.

is_primary_owner.description: True only for rank 1; other ranked owners are false.

added_at.description: Team membership creation time; null for ranked owners.

owner_rank.description: Rank 1 through 4 for an owner; null for team-only members.

owner_available.description: Active tenant membership for owners; null for team-only members.

client_account_owners.description: Current ordered account assignments, preserving unavailable historical owners and the ordered-owner reader’s person redaction.
client_account_owners.grain: One row per (client_id, rank); each user has at most one rank for a client.
limitations: Only current authorized nonarchived clients are visible. Query limits do not establish tenant-wide completeness.
No assignments means zero rows. Unavailable historical assignments remain present with all person fields null.
The roster relationship is guaranteed by these paired projections, not a database foreign key to a view.
Ownership grants no client access. A query result is a read snapshot, not permission to replace assignments.

client_id.description: Canonical client ID; include it in owner/roster joins.

rank.description: Canonical rank 1 through 4; not a score.

user_id.description: Assigned user ID, retained when the historical owner becomes unavailable.

label.description: Primary, Secondary, Tertiary or Quaternary for rank 1 through 4.

available.description: True only when the assigned user is an active member and has an email.

person_id.description: Assigned person ID only when available; otherwise null.

email.description: Assigned person email only when available; otherwise null.

first_name.description: Assigned person first name only when available; otherwise null.

last_name.description: Assigned person last name only when available; otherwise null.

assignment_version.description: Observed client account-owner version; not authorization or a current write precondition.

client_targets.description: Full stored client target records and engagement priorities. Directory attributes are saved snapshots, not current representation or enrichment.
client_targets.grain: One saved target row per (client_id, id); (client_id, member_id) is also unique.
limitations: Only current authorized nonarchived clients are visible. Query limits do not establish tenant-wide completeness.
No fresh staff classification or representedFacilities enrichment is performed. Stored values can be stale.
Missing fresh representation is not evidence that no facility is represented; use the canonical Targets reader for that question.
Manual and Meri-added saved rows are included. Recommendations not yet saved are not targets. No hidden list cap.

member_id.description: Directory identifier; may be a congressional, staff or slash-containing state ID. Not a UUID.

source_directory.description: Stored congress, state or staff directory discriminator.

party.description: Stored party snapshot; nullable and not a controlled cross-directory enum.

state.description: Stored state/district snapshot, possibly a named state district; not a two-letter state filter.

stored_staff_kind.description: Saved staff classification only; may differ from the freshly resolved Targets UI.

tier.description: Stored engagement priority, 1 highest through 3; null is untiered.

source.description: Stored manual or meri attribution; not a claim of verified source evidence.

added_by_user_id.description: Attributed creator, possibly null; no additional read ACL.

added_at.description: When the target was saved, not directory freshness or a row version.

client_profiles.description: Saved client business profile scalars from ClientsService.get, with full description and contact text.
client_profiles.grain: One currently visible saved client per client_id.
limitations: Current nonarchived clients and current wall grants only. SQL filters and row/byte limits do not establish complete client coverage.
Array fields are in client_profile_codes. Empty arrays remain empty; they are not negative eligibility evidence.
Arbitrary intakeData/profileNotes, full capabilities, facilities, submissions and advocacy remain at the existing full paged get_client_context reader. This is not its replacement.
Logo storage/signing and provider sync bookkeeping are not exposed. Saved identity references do not imply a fresh provider match.

client_id.description: Canonical client ID. Include it in child-record joins.

website.description: Saved website; no fetch or verification.

description.description: Full saved description, not a summary.

primary_contact_email.description: Saved primary contact email; not an identity-directory lookup.

status.description: Stored client lifecycle status; archived clients are excluded.

profile_status.description: Stored profile status, separate from client lifecycle status.

uei.description: Stored UEI identifier; leading characters are preserved.

canonical_entity_id.description: Confirmed saved canonical entity reference; does not grant access to its directory record.

created_by_user_id.description: Saved creator UUID; not a joined user profile.

updated_at.description: Record update time; not provider freshness.

client_profile_codes.description: Typed saved client array entries, preserving their original order and duplicate entries.
client_profile_codes.grain: One stored array element per client_id, family and one-based position.
limitations: Current nonarchived clients and current wall grants only. SQL filters and row/byte limits do not establish complete client coverage.
Empty arrays yield no child rows; join client_profiles to distinguish visible clients from missing entries. Empty applicant/certification arrays mean unknown, not ineligible.
Codes remain strings; LDA IDs are identifiers, not monetary values. This is saved association state, not current public filing coverage.

client_id.description: Canonical client ID. Include it in child-record joins.

family.description: One of submission_tracks, issue_codes, naics_codes, psc_codes, applicant_types, set_aside_certifications, lda_client_ids.

position.description: One-based position within the stored array, transported as an exact integer string.

value.description: Exact saved code/label or decimal-text LDA identifier. No normalization, inference or provider lookup.

client_people.description: Saved client people and recorded reporting hierarchy. Read-time title inference remains with ClientPeopleService.
client_people.grain: One stored person per canonical id and client_id; duplicate email rows are not deduplicated.
limitations: Current nonarchived clients and current wall grants only. SQL filters and row/byte limits do not establish complete client coverage.
The canonical people reader overlays never-inferred auto_title rows. Use get_client_context people for that current presentation; stored_* fields deliberately do not claim inferred parity.
No organization-wide identity directory, inferred relationship graph, mail or meeting body access.

client_id.description: Canonical client ID. Include it in child-record joins.

notes.description: Full saved notes, not an excerpt.

stored_hierarchy_level.description: Stored hierarchy level; null may mean unplaced or awaiting the existing read-time inference overlay.

reports_to_person_id.description: Saved manager ID within this client; null is no recorded manager.

stored_placement_confidence.description: Stored decimal confidence, preserved exactly; null for a manual placement. Not a current inference score.

stored_review_required.description: Saved review flag before any read-time title inference.

client_contacts.description: Saved EngagementContact business fields for currently visible client associations.
client_contacts.grain: One saved EngagementContact per id associated with a visible client.
limitations: Current nonarchived clients and current wall grants only. SQL filters and row/byte limits do not establish complete client coverage.
Null-client contacts are excluded from this client projection. Raw metadata, inferred associations and directory records stay with their existing owners.
No deduplication by display name or email across the two distinct people/contact owners.

client_id.description: Canonical client ID. Include it in child-record joins.

id.description: Canonical EngagementContact ID; distinct from ClientPerson IDs.

directory_entry_id.description: Saved external directory identifier; not a UUID or a grant.

client_engagement_tasks.description: Saved client-associated EngagementTask business fields under the current exact task reader client/wall scope.
client_engagement_tasks.grain: One saved client-associated EngagementTask per id and client_id.
limitations: Only current nonarchived clients and current wall grants are visible. SQL filters and row/byte limits do not establish complete saved-work coverage.

Selected client is fixed by current Core authority. General queries may cover all currently visible clients; use owner_user_id for assigned-to-me filtering, matching the current reader optional assignment filter.
Null-client General tasks and research_portfolio_action tasks are excluded. Q06 PlannerTask is a separate owner and is never included.
Meeting/contact/mail/source linkage IDs and their bodies are omitted; use the exact task reader for its separately checked links and source-change receipt. Saved descriptions are returned as saved.

client_id.description: Canonical current visible client ID; include it in joins.

id.description: Canonical EngagementTask ID; never a PlannerTask ID.

owner_user_id.description: Saved assignee UUID; null means unassigned.

due_date.description: Saved due date; null is no deadline.

status.description: Saved todo/in_progress/blocked/done/canceled status; no open-only default.

source_type.description: Saved origin kind; Research Portfolio source rows are excluded.

client_action_items.description: Saved ActionRecommendation business scalars; evidence remains at the exact action-item reader.
client_action_items.grain: One saved ActionRecommendation per id and client_id.
limitations: Only current nonarchived clients and current wall grants are visible. SQL filters and row/byte limits do not establish complete saved-work coverage.
Target audience, confidence bands and evidence JSON are not exposed as raw JSON. query_action_items supplies complete typed fields and revalidates current nonsuperseded source documents.
These saved assertions are not fresh source evidence or an execution approval. No source document or artifact access is inferred from program/delta references.

client_id.description: Canonical current visible client ID; include it in joins.

program_id.description: Saved program reference, not a source grant.

delta_id.description: Saved change reference, not current evidence.

client_tracked_bills.description: Saved manually tracked bill records owned by IntelligenceManualBillTracking, without public bill hydration.
client_tracked_bills.grain: One saved client/bill tracking record per id; source uniqueness is client_id plus bill_id.
limitations: Only current nonarchived clients and current wall grants are visible. SQL filters and row/byte limits do not establish complete saved-work coverage.
No public bill text/status join or cross-database bridge. Use the canonical public bill reader for current public evidence.
last_seen_* alert reconciliation state is not exposed or presented as source freshness.

client_id.description: Canonical current visible client ID; include it in joins.

bill_id.description: Canonical public bill text ID such as 119-hr-1234; not a UUID.

source.description: Saved tracking origin, including null for legacy rows.

created_by.description: Saved Clerk creator identifier; never an application user UUID.

client_outreach_campaigns.description: Saved EngagementCampaign scalar records, matching listCampaigns/getCampaign client visibility, with full saved body.
client_outreach_campaigns.grain: One client-associated saved EngagementCampaign per id and client_id.
limitations: Only current nonarchived clients and current wall grants are visible. SQL filters and row/byte limits do not establish complete saved-work coverage.
Null-client campaigns are excluded. Raw sourceContext/metadata, generated artifacts, send intents and provider receipts remain with their owners.
Classic OutreachRecord is a different creator-only owner with linked meeting/prep/debrief and source-grant checks; it is not included here. This relation never supplies send authority.

client_id.description: Canonical current visible client ID; include it in joins.

id.description: Canonical EngagementCampaign ID; not an OutreachRecord ID.

created_by_user_id.description: Saved campaign creator UUID. The existing campaign read policy is tenant/client-wall scoped, not creator-only.

status.description: Saved campaign status; not a current provider receipt.

body.description: Full saved campaign body, not a 2000-character excerpt.

sent_at.description: Saved sent timestamp; not proof of current delivery.

client_campaign_recipients.description: Saved EngagementCampaignRecipient rows joined through their same-tenant visible campaign.
client_campaign_recipients.grain: One saved recipient row per id within its currently visible campaign and client.
limitations: Only current nonarchived clients and current wall grants are visible. SQL filters and row/byte limits do not establish complete saved-work coverage.
Same-tenant parent linkage is mandatory. Duplicate email/name rows are preserved. Raw metadata and external contact-directory records are excluded.
Joining recipients expands campaign rows; aggregate parents before joining when counting campaigns. Counts of recipients are not delivery counts.

client_id.description: Canonical current visible client ID; include it in joins.

campaign_id.description: Canonical parent EngagementCampaign ID; join with client_id.

email.description: Saved recipient email; not a generic identity-directory read.

status.description: Saved recipient status, not fresh provider delivery evidence.
